title: Bringing Home the Dogs of War
description: Afghanistan’s Dog’s of war are coming home with the help of a former British Royal Marine. A veteran of Helmand province in 2006, Pen Farthing has since returned to Afghanistan on his own animal rescue. Produced by Joe Sheffer.
keywords: british royal marine, animal rescue, Joe Sheffer, Pen Farthing, Afghanistan, military working dog, Helmand Province
